scalars.scalar_value: Bachelors degree in engineering (Biomedical, Clinical, Mechanical, Electrical), engineering technology, or related field AND minimum three (3) years of experience in engineering or a directly related field OR Minimum six (6) years of experience in engineering or a directly related field.
One (1) year of experience managing operational or project budgets.
Minimum one (1) year of experience in a leadership role with or without direct reports.

items.item_text: Bachelors degree in engineering (Biomedical, Clinical, Mechanical, Electrical), engineering technology, or related field AND minimum three (3) years of experience in engineering or a directly related field OR Minimum six (6) years of experience in engineering or a directly related field.
Minimum one (1) year of experience in a leadership role with or without direct reports.
One (1) year of experience managing operational or project budgets.
Minimum of two (2) years of experience in project management.
Three (3) years of experience working in a large matrixed organization.
Two (2) years of experience in health care.

Promotes learning in others by proactively providing and/or developing information, resources, advice, and expertise with coworkers and members; builds relationships with cross-functional/external stakeholders and customers. Listens to, seeks, and addresses performance feedback; proactively provides actionable feedback to others and to managers. Pursues self-development; creates and executes plans to capitalize on strengths and develop weaknesses; leads by influencing others through technical explanations and examples and provides options and recommendations. Adopts new responsibilities; adapts to and learns from change, challenges, and feedback; demonstrates flexibility in approaches to work; champions change and helps others adapt to new tasks and processes. Facilitates team collaboration to support a business outcome.

Completes work assignments autonomously and supports business-specific projects by applying expertise in subject area and business knowledge to generate creative solutions; encourages team members to adapt to and follow all procedures and policies. Collaborates cross-functionally and/or externally to achieve effective business decisions; provides recommendations and solves complex problems; escalates high-priority issues or risks, as appropriate; monitors progress and results. Supports the development of work plans to meet business priorities and deadlines; identifies resources to accomplish priorities and deadlines. Identifies, speaks up, and capitalizes on improvement opportunities across teams; uses influence to guide others and engages stakeholders to achieve appropriate solutions.

Supports clinical systems by: serving as a trusted consultant to user groups and strategic partners to develop equipment configurations, review facility construction plans, and equipment lists, and provide technical and environment requirements for deployment for moderately complex projects for a market; and collaborating with others on incident investigations and equipment performance analysis on moderately complex problems to determine root causes of issues and develop solutions.

Provides oversight for compliance by: coordinating with stakeholders to ensure technical systems and processes are used and maintained in a manner that ensures compliance with all relevant government regulations, accreditation, and industry standards; and reviewing FDA and nonregulatory Hazard Alerts to determine the appropriate level of response in collaboration with the National Product Recall Management team.

Provides technical expertise for clinical systems by: independently performing moderately technical testing on various clinical systems and associated equipment and technology; identifying, monitoring, and resolving moderately complex issues related to clinical systems and healthcare technologies that present a risk to the enterprise; recording and maintaining documentation for design specifications, testing, and validating of new and innovative technology to be incorporated into multiple markets in alignment with standards and requirements; independently providing technical expertise and consult for operational impacts of existing and new systems and technologies and prioritizing assigned projects within established timeframes; and driving cyber security trends in healthcare and ensure implementation in accordance with industry and company standards for healthcare technology.

Executes strategies for clinical systems by: performing moderately complex healthcare technology assessments, needs analysis, and site planning to identify appropriate and relevant healthcare technologies that can be effectively implemented; independently assessing and implementing moderately complex systems that support networking, integration, and interoperability of healthcare technologies within multiple care delivery settings; applying broad strategies when conducting cost-benefit analysis and providing recommendations; and consulting with leaders to gain buy-in and alignment in support of the development and production of healthcare technology strategic plans and forecasts, procurement programs, and service contracts for multiple care delivery settings.

Facilitates innovative planning related to healthcare technologies by: researching and assessing new health care related technologies, strategies, and concepts and disseminating this information as appropriate across the enterprise; and conducting research to stay abreast of cutting-edge technology and products (e.g., attending conferences or tradeshows, vendor product events).

Develops, analyzes, and manages technology plans by: ensuring strategy and scope identification, managing schedules, evaluating inter-dependencies, and resource forecasting for multiple technology plans; and monitoring overall performance (e.g., on time, on budget, within scope, and with quality) against plan, ensuring measurement of business benefits and outcomes, and making adjustments as needed.
